captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a utility blimp or airship. It features a large, aerodynamic light gray envelope (hull) with a boxy cruciform tail consisting of a vertical fin with a movable rudder and horizontal tailplanes with elevators. Suspended below the centerline of the hull by thin struts is a compact, dark gray rectangular gondola. Mounted to the sides of the gondola on short vectoring pylons are twin orange engine pods with spinning propeller shafts.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a utility blimp with a thick light gray envelope, a boxy cruciform tail assembly, and a dark gray underslung gondola. Mount twin orange engine pods on the sides of the gondola via short vectoring pylons, and include rotatable propellers on the pods, a movable rudder on the vertical fin, and elevators on the tailplanes.
captions.factory: The code constructs the blimp starting with the envelope using an elongated loft or scaled cylinder. It then creates the boxy tail fins (vertical and horizontal) using thin box shapes, attaching the rudder and elevators via revolute joints. The gondola is modeled as a rectangular box suspended by thin cylinder struts. The side engine pods are created as cylinders with orange material, connected to the gondola via vectoring pylons with revolute joints, and finished with propeller shafts that rotate on continuous joints.
